metadata.input_timing: Actual plant.last_input after original command issuance; same held command for all five solves.
metadata.state_timing: Raw bridge state immediately before/after each completed1ms solve. Plugin clock is separate from relative control time.
metadata.contact_timing: Full native last-solve contact rows16 after every1ms; force samples are not labeled exact solver impulse records.
metadata.pre_contact_timing: Before rows are the preceding reported solve snapshot, copied once before the hold and carried from each post-step copy; not a continuous force measurement.
metadata.force_convention: Columns7:10 are the published force on the wheel/body in world N, not an impulse to divide by dt again. Normal points ground-to-wheel; no normalization/filtering is applied here.
metadata.couple_coverage: Current bridge does not export per-contact torque/couple or total solver constraint wrench. Reserved columns13:16 are zero-filled ABI padding, not measured couples.
metadata.mapping_convention: Logical bridge tag names plus known mirror geom/body mapping; mirror IDs are not Gazebo entity IDs.
metadata.qvel_convention: Offline-derived from cached raw24: base linear velocity world, free-joint angular velocity body, joint rates scalar; no extra pull/forward.
metadata.dt_convention: step_dt_s is the bridge reported actual physics step. Native-relative after-step time_s and separate raw before/after bridge clocks are retained.
metadata.disturbance_convention: Applied world input wrench is passed to fork AddWorldWrench at configured fork COM; it is not a contact-couple measurement.
metadata.stepping_scope: Only registered physical.step holds splitrun5 into five run1. No extra command/observer/pull/forward/reset.
metadata.parity_status: Caller must verify unchanged prefix/control and physical evolution before causal interpretation.

measurement_boundary: Solver/contact hooks copy inputs/output and delegate installed functions unchanged. No new commands or estimator updates.
